description: Browse, inspect, and install shared skills, agents, and MCP servers from the Contextium Marketplace. Set `action`: "search" to browse listings (optionally filter by itemType skill/agent/mcp_server, category, or query); "get" for a listing's full details by slug; "install" to add a listing to a workspace by slug. Typically search first to find a slug, then get or install with it.

action.description: search: browse listings; get: full details by slug; install: add to workspace
